text: Just peel it off, stick it on, scan the QR code, and boom, your car has its own sentry mode. If you're tired of finding scratches and dents with no idea who did it, this is a game changer. The SendMore DC-1 has a built-in battery, so there's no hard wiring, no complicated installation, and no need to tap into your car battery. Its 360-degree rotating camera lets you check different angles right from your phone, even when you're away from your car. It can detect suspicious activity, send alerts to your phone, and record important footage to help protect your ride. If your car doesn't have built-in parking surveillance, tap the yellow cart and check it out.
